entities.summary: James Nathan Browning was an American politician and lawyer who served as the 20th lieutenant governor of Texas from 1899 to 1903. He had earlier served as a member of the Texas House of Representatives . A later Lieutenant Governor, Rick Perry, made the following comments when he was sworn in on January 19, 1999.One hundred years and two days ago, Governor Joseph Sayers and Lieutenant Governor James Browning came to the 11-year-old Capitol building during one of the coldest winters ever recorded in Texas and took the oath of office.
